scope: shared regression fixtures and independent generators
requirements: Fail closed on ambiguous credential extents; following flags/query names may be masked.
Inspect every generic ASCII URL scheme candidate in lists, paths and queries without repeated suffix scans.
Cover RFC userinfo punctuation, malformed braces and CR/LF, JSON slash escaping, and fully percent-encoded nested URLs.
Consume dash-leading flag values; preserve ordinary prose.
Align explicit ASCII boundaries and CR/LF/U+2028/U+2029 line starts.
Handle folded authorization, complete cookie headers, arrow assignments, XML, and common glued aliases.
Retain an independent reviewer generator alongside the original generator.

additional_corpus_fixes: Prefer rpcauth over the weak auth suffix for rpc_auth.
Mask standalone Nostr nsec private keys.
regressions.original_fixture_changes: Reviewed deliberate fail-closed masking of following flags, record/query tails, ambiguous URL @ carriers, and RFC apostrophe userinfo.
final_hardening: Treat == and :> as value punctuation; recognize only => and :=, with := following explicit-assignment prose/status rules.
Require a complete following quoted key and separator, or ordinary unquoted prose, before ending a value at a comma; mask glued text after closing bracket/quote runs.
Carry empty and numeric colon prefixes across embedded schemes so scheme-like password bytes stay inside the redaction.

allowed_nonsecret_changes: One mislabeled JSON password value is correctly masked.
Raw @ in URL paths/queries may remove hostname context.
Nested URLs with userinfo are now redacted, including SSH usernames.

linearity.algorithm: Scheme matches partition candidate segments; token ends are cached and each segment is inspected a bounded number of times. Offset-preserving decoding uses three fixed passes; escape runs are counted without recursive JSON parsing.

warmed_webview.method: Two full-size warmups, then minimum of three CPU samples per shape and size.
warmed_webview.cold_outlier: A development dash_kw_quote sample reached 9.95x; the final single-sample run reached 6.57x. Neither reproduced in the warmed recheck.

initial_development_attempts: An initial independent-webview harness failed while carrying the generated corpus in a child-process output buffer; switched to a streamed disposable file under target.
Targeted development checks exposed quote-tail, prose-punctuation, NBSP and URL/key-composition cases; these were fixed and included in the final regressions.
Output digests were updated only after both runtimes independently produced the same stream and passed sentinel/preservation assertions.

initial_gate.interruption: Reports/contracts intentionally interrupted with SIGINT (exit 130) after manual review found extra ambiguous-tail cases. Six earlier shards passed; no assertion failure or timeout caused the interruption. The interrupted process group was audited empty before further tests.

documented_limits: Finite credential alias and command-prefix tables; unknown formats/aliases and unmarked prose are best-effort.
Ordinary prose words may remain readable in ambiguous help/short-alias contexts; explicit assignments/typed secret fields are required for such secret values.
JSON string nesting is handled by direct escape-run counting (regressions through 12 enclosing layers); arbitrary encodings are not parsed.
URL percent encoding is decoded for up to three layers; deeper percent encoding remains best-effort.
Raw @ and malformed URL userinfo may remove path/query/hostname context.
Three known webview bare-mnemonic heuristic differences from Python remain.
Native Rust-only diagnostics have not yet adopted this scanner contract.

requirements: Replace split_whitespace with the same keyed-first, whitespace-preserving forward scanners.
Mirror longest recognized aliases before weak aliases, prose guards, command context, ASCII boundaries and the four line terminators.
Consume dash-leading flag values, unquoted ampersand/pipe tails, => and := assignments, XML secret elements, all cookies, and folded authorization/cookie lines.
Inspect every generic ASCII scheme occurrence; partition bounded candidates and cache token bounds rather than rescanning suffixes.
Cover every RFC userinfo character and malformed brace/CRLF carriers; do not hide username context when keyed redaction removes @.
Mirror offset-preserving escaped-slash and three-layer percent decoding, and quote escape-run counting without a fixed JSON nesting cap.
Align key-material backstops (including Nostr nsec), descriptors, bearer/sk, and exact replacement strings.
Run both independent 100,000-case generators, the exact shared/new/reviewer corpora, 7,410 flag variants, and 128 CPU shapes at 40k/100k/400k through native insert paths.
Keep the three known webview mnemonic differences explicit; prove arbitrary native stderr cannot bypass the floor.

process_audit.scope: Same-user processes bound to this worktree by cwd/argv, then its disposable TMPDIR/test-Python binding or verification runner name; audit process and its ancestors excluded.
